source_urls: POST https://data.medicaid.gov/api/1/datastore/query/<dataset id>/0 (two grouped queries per agent and year: by state/quarter/suppression flag, and by product_name/suppression flag excluding state XX; each sums number_of_prescriptions and units_reimbursed and counts rows where product_name LIKE '<PREFIX>%' for any listed prefix)
caveats: Medicaid only (fee-for-service and managed care combined). Not all-payer volume.
No dollar columns were requested or stored.

Counts are for every use of the drug, not Tourette syndrome. Most of these agents are used mainly for other conditions (ADHD, hypertension, schizophrenia, bipolar disorder, epilepsy, migraine, Huntington chorea, tardive dyskinesia).

CMS suppresses any NDC/state/quarter row with fewer than 11 prescriptions. Suppressed rows have no counts and are EXCLUDED from the sums, so true volume is higher, especially for low-volume drugs and small states. 'suppressed_rows_excluded' out of 'ndc_rows' shows how much of each cell was hidden.
A cell where every row was suppressed has number_of_prescriptions and units_reimbursed set to null (unknown), never 0.

Products are matched by PREFIX on SDUD's 10-character product_name field (long names are truncated, e.g. ARIPIPRAZO). Names entered by labelers vary; see 'product_breakdown' for exactly which names were captured. Products whose SDUD name does not start with a listed prefix are missed.

All formulations are pooled: e.g. clonidine includes tablets, patches, ER and injection; aripiprazole and risperidone include long-acting injectables (Abilify Maintena, Aristada, Risperdal Consta, Perseris, Uzedy, Rykindo); guanfacine includes IR and ER.
units_reimbursed mixes unit types (tablets, mL, patches) and must not be compared across formulations or agents.
State 'XX' rows are CMS's national totals and are kept separately in 'national_xx_rows'; they are not in 'rows'. XX totals can differ from the sum of states because suppression is applied per row.
Recent years are revised by states after first publication; the latest year is partial (see quarters_present_by_year).
units_reimbursed is a quantity of drug units, not money, despite the name.
